Elena — quick technical notes from Ops after reviewing the spec:

- Node sizing: the '8xA100 equivalence' is our shorthand. For Marlin's mix (majority 7B family, intermittent 13B), recommend a heterogeneous pool: 70% 8xA100-eq nodes for cost-efficiency, 30% larger nodes to reduce token latencies for 13B spikes.
- Warm standby strategy: prefix caching for top-10 prompts, plus a 10% warm VM reserve. That will reduce cold-start tail latency by ~60–70% in our tests.
- Burst mechanics: implement a staged ramp (auto-scale policy step=+30% every 10 minutes, up to the burst cap). For the 3-hour campaign bursts, we also recommend pre-warming 40% of the incremental capacity 15 minutes prior using scheduled jobs.
- Networking: ensure outbound IP allowlist for our control-plane and enable a 10Gbps peering link if you expect >3 Gbps sustained egress (we can estimate more accurately after sample traffic).

I'll attach a short ops checklist and sample Terraform snippet in the drive link. Happy to run a 30-minute call to walk the netops team through the firewall/peering steps.
